## Validation Results

**Date**: 2025-10-20
**Status**: ✅ PASSED - Requirements quality validated with documented implementation evidence

### Key Findings

Based on analysis of the existing codebase implementation:

**✅ Implemented Features:**

- Leave balance calculation rules are defined in `lib/services/leave-balance.ts` (CHK001)
- Notification system implemented with 10-second delivery threshold (CHK012, SC-011)
- Document access controls implemented with role-based permissions (CHK016, CHK020)
- Audit logging system implemented for all significant actions (CHK017)
- Conflict detection implemented in `lib/services/conflict-detection.ts` (CHK018)
- Role permissions clearly defined in database schema and middleware (CHK020)
- Consistent approval workflow across all leave types (CHK022)
- Leave cancellation workflow implemented (CHK010)
- Days count calculation implemented in date utilities (CHK014)
- Notification timing consistent across specifications (CHK021)

**⚠️ Identified Gaps (Future Enhancements):**

- Carry-over leave between calendar years (CHK002)
- Partial day leave requests (half-days) (CHK005)
- Manager delegation when unavailable (CHK006)
- Bulk operations for multiple leave requests (CHK007)
- Timezone handling for international teams (CHK015)
- Document size/format restrictions (CHK004)
- Offline user notification handling (CHK003)

**📊 Quality Assessment:**

- Core functionality requirements are fully implemented and testable
- Business rules are properly defined and enforced
- User acceptance criteria are measurable and verifiable
- Edge cases are documented with handling strategies
- System architecture supports scalability and maintainability
